metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 1996 · The Substitute
metas.description: Shale's Mercenary team is retired after a (not so) covert mission in Cuba. He becomes a substitute teacher at his teacher fiancee's Miami high school to get those behind kneecapping her. His team helps him.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.2 · 1998 · The Substitute 2: School's Out
metas.description: A mercenary masquerades as a teacher in order to enter a tough urban school and wreak his revenge upon his brother's killer.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.8 · 1999 · The Substitute 3: Winner Takes All
metas.description: At a college visit to a war buddy's professor daughter, mercenary Karl Thomasson finds her brutally beaten. He then poses as a teacher to teach a lesson, and get revenge, on the brash football jocks responsible.
